era.name: ซอร์ด แอนด์ ชีลด์

description.text: V Starter Deck: Sword & Shield, the first starter product of the Sword & Shield series in Thai: a random ready-to-play 60-card deck with damage counters and a rule book, and always one Pokémon V. This set holds every card the decks could contain.

tell.text: An "SC1D" mark with a "T" beside it at the bottom left, and a number out of 164
